# 【工作流使用指南】
## [点击查看详细编辑器视频教程](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1WQ3J6bE8X)
## 1.点击任务轨道中片段可编辑详细提示词/时长

## 2.编辑器中的任务模式选择项：默认时代表视频生成模式是文生、首帧或首尾帧（取决于编辑器中的资源数量），参考时为参考生视频（最大支持9图3音频3视频），为尾帧时是尾帧生视频

## 3.[RH版本问题]：线上版本比较早(有点小bug)，目前视频连线是断开的，需要使用视频时，需展开`MultiTrack Task Output`将videos连到`Minimax H3 To video`；本地可直接连上没有视频时会自动过滤。

<Subject 1> is Shen Zhi, the young female sword cultivator from <Picture 1>, preserving her refined youthful East Asian facial identity, long black half-up hairstyle with delicate pale ornaments, white-and-light-blue layered cultivation robes, slender proportions, and elegant flowing fabric.

She is a strict single-sword cultivator. She always uses exactly ONE slender straight sword shown in the reference and exactly ONE matching scabbard.

The sword identity is permanently locked:
the same silver blade, the same blade length, the same hilt design, the same guard shape, and the same scabbard remain consistent throughout the entire video.

Shen Zhi uses only one sword during combat.
Her right hand is the only hand that holds the sword.

Before drawing:
- her right hand grips the single sword hilt.
- her left hand only stabilizes the single scabbard attached at her waist.
- the left hand contains no weapon.

After drawing:
- the same single sword remains in her right hand.
- her left hand becomes completely empty.
- her left hand is only used for balance, robe movement, defensive gestures, or natural body motion.

The sword is one continuous physical object from the beginning of the draw until the final clash.

Never create:
- a second sword,
- a mirrored sword,
- a duplicate blade,
- a hidden blade,
- an extra weapon,
- a sword appearing in the opposite hand.

Maintain clear visual separation:
Shen Zhi = one slender straight sword.
Yan Qinghan = one long silver spear.

Her combat identity is agile, determined, and precise, relying on evasive footwork, close-range entry, deflection, sliding contact along the opponent's weapon, and fast counter-thrusts.


<Subject 2> is Yan Qinghan, the senior female spear cultivator from <Picture 2>, preserving her cold refined East Asian facial identity, long black hair tied in a high traditional style, dark navy embroidered martial robes, black waist belt, slender athletic proportions, and stern commanding presence.

She always uses the same long silver spear shown in the reference.

The spear identity is permanently locked:
the same long shaft, same silver spearhead, and same weapon proportions remain consistent throughout the entire video.

The spear must always remain visually different from Shen Zhi's sword:
long shaft, large reach, pole weapon structure.

Her combat identity is dominant and oppressive, using broad body-driven spear motions, long-range thrusting pressure, rotational recovery, sweeping control, and counter-lifting attacks.


<Subject 3> is the ancient mountain cultivation-sect gate environment from <Picture 3>, preserving the broad stone ceremonial courtyard, ascending stone stairways, large traditional timber halls, roofed gates, stone lanterns, mature trees, surrounding mountain terrain, drifting mist, and deep architectural perspective.

The target action takes place on the central open stone platform where both long weapons can move freely.

[reference generation]

The target video is a ten-second vertical cinematic xianxia confrontation featuring <Subject 2> challenging <Subject 1> in <Subject 3>.

The sequence begins with hostile spoken dialogue and restrained character acting, then explodes into a seamless single-sword-versus-spear duel.

<Subject 2> uses the spear's reach to initiate the attack, while <Subject 1> deflects, closes distance, and counters.

Shen Zhi remains a strict single-sword fighter throughout the entire sequence.

Her complete weapon continuity:
- one sword only,
- one scabbard only,
- one continuous blade identity,
- one sword held by one hand.

The entire scene is presented as one uninterrupted ACT-style cinematic long take with strong backlighting, shallow depth of field, realistic weapon contact, brief impact slowdowns, environmental dust and leaves, and no subtitles or music.

<Subject 1> (appears throughout [Shot 1]):

fully_preserved -

Shen Zhi's facial identity, black hairstyle, pale hair ornaments, white-and-light-blue layered robes, body proportions, single straight sword, single scabbard, and elegant youthful cultivation appearance remain consistent throughout dialogue and combat.

Her determined expressions, evasive movement, close-range entry, sword deflections, and counter-thrusts are target-video actions rather than alterations to her referenced identity.

Weapon continuity is strictly preserved:

- Shen Zhi owns exactly one sword.
- The sword shown during combat is the same sword drawn at the beginning.
- The sword remains in her right hand.
- Her left hand remains empty after the draw.

detailed_description:

The target video uses a premium live-action female-oriented xianxia-drama aesthetic with photorealistic cinematic texture.

It has the visual character of Sony FX3 photography with an 85mm f/1.4 long lens, very shallow depth of field, a 1/2 black diffusion filter, gentle halation around bright edges, soft optical bloom, realistic skin texture, translucent fabric detail, and restrained high-end matte tonality.

Strong hard side-backlight creates wide golden rims around hair, shoulders, embroidered cloth, sword edges, and the polished spear.

Soft frontal bounce keeps both faces luminous and produces clear catchlights.

Thin mountain mist turns the intense backlight into visible volumetric rays.



[Shot 1]

A single seamless ten-second long take begins at low waist height on the central stone platform of <Subject 3>.

The camera slowly pushes between the two women rather than establishing a distant wide shot.

<Subject 2> stands slightly higher on the stone paving, her silver spear planted loosely beside her, dark embroidered sleeves shifting in the mountain wind.

The camera rises into a medium close-up as she looks down at <Subject 1> with a faint contemptuous smile and narrowed eyes.

In a cold, dismissive tone, <Subject 2> says:

<d>[Chinese] 沈栀，就凭你，今天怕是要交代在这了～</d>


Without cutting, the camera arcs across the narrow space between them and settles into a close medium view of <Subject 1>.

Wind lifts loose strands of her black hair and the translucent outer layer of her pale-blue robe.

Her expression changes from calm restraint to focused determination.

Her eyes become sharp and controlled.

The camera clearly shows Shen Zhi's waist area:

one single sword,
one single scabbard,
no other weapon.


Shen Zhi begins the sword draw.

Her right hand firmly grips the hilt of the only sword attached to her waist.

Her left hand grips only the body of the same single scabbard to stabilize it.

The left hand contains no blade and no weapon.


The sword draw is one continuous realistic motion:

the same single silver blade slowly slides out from the same single scabbard.

The camera clearly maintains:

right hand = sword handle,
left hand = empty scabbard.

The sword is never duplicated during the draw.

No second blade appears.
No sword appears in the left hand.
No mirrored weapon shape appears during fast movement.


The same sword becomes fully unsheathed.

The empty scabbard remains attached at Shen Zhi's waist.

Her left hand releases naturally and becomes empty.

From this moment onward, Shen Zhi fights only with this one sword held in her right hand.


Looking directly toward <Subject 2>, <Subject 1> answers with controlled anger and firm conviction:

<d>[Chinese] 晏清寒，你忤逆师门，今天我要替天行道！！</d>


As the last syllable lands, the camera immediately accelerates into a third-person ACT-style tracking position behind and slightly beside <Subject 2>.

She drives from her rear leg and launches a direct long-range spear thrust toward <Subject 1>.

The lens follows the spear's forward momentum while keeping both faces and the weapon relationship readable.


<Subject 1> pivots diagonally away from the attack line.

She uses her one single sword to meet the spear shaft.

The sword does not block with brute force.

Instead, the blade slides along the spear shaft and redirects the attack.

The same single sword remains visible in her right hand.

Her left hand remains empty and assists only through body balance and robe movement.


Metal contact produces a sharp spark burst, a brief micro-slowdown, and one short controlled camera jolt.


The camera swings behind <Subject 1>.

She immediately follows the deflected spear inward, using close-range footwork.

Her single sword slides along Yan Qinghan's spear shaft as she enters the distance.

She turns through the opening and sends a fast precise counter-thrust toward <Subject 2>.


Yan Qinghan retracts the spear with a strong waist rotation.

She rolls the long spear shaft into a defensive circular path and intercepts Shen Zhi's sword.

The impact creates a second metallic clash.

Sparks scatter laterally while their sleeves and hair whip outward from the force.


For the final exchange, the camera drops to a low three-quarter angle while remaining in the same continuous move.

Shen Zhi advances with her single sword held in her right hand.

Yan Qinghan responds with an upward reverse spear lift.


The final weapon interaction is a clear sword-versus-spear lock:

Shen Zhi's single sword presses diagonally against Yan Qinghan's spear shaft.

Yan Qinghan's weapon remains clearly a long spear with a visible shaft.

The composition clearly shows:

one sword,
one spear.

Never two swords.
Never crossed sword shapes.
Never duplicated blades.


The impact sends dust upward from the stone paving.

Nearby dry leaves spiral around their legs.

The intense backlight catches the suspended particles.

The collision briefly slows time before both women recoil half a step.


The camera makes a restrained partial orbit and ends in a tense medium framing:

Shen Zhi stands holding her single sword in her right hand.

Her empty left hand remains visible.

Yan Qinghan holds her single long spear.

Their weapons remain locked in a final sword-versus-spear confrontation.

Neither weapon lands a final blow.



weapon_identity_lock:

Shen Zhi weapon rules:

- Exactly one sword exists in the entire video.
- The sword shown during the draw is the same sword used during combat.
- The sword is always held by Shen Zhi's right hand.
- The left hand never holds a sword.
- The left hand never creates a weapon.
- The scabbard remains a separate empty object after the draw.
- No weapon duplication during camera movement.
- No duplicate sword caused by motion blur.
- No extra blade reflection that resembles another sword.
- No twin swords.
- No dual wielding.


Yan Qinghan weapon rules:

- Exactly one spear exists in the entire video.
- The spear remains a long pole weapon.
- The spear shaft must remain visually obvious.
- The spearhead must never resemble a second sword.


Weapon contrast:

Shen Zhi:
single slender straight sword,
shorter blade,
held in right hand.

Yan Qinghan:
single long silver spear,
long shaft,
two-handed spear techniques.

The final image must always communicate:

one sword versus one spear.



overall_soundscape:

No music.

Continuous high-mountain wind, faint tree movement, distant open-air sect ambience, soft fabric flutter, hair ornaments moving lightly, controlled breathing, one continuous sword-unsheathing friction sound, spear shaft movement, rapid weapon whooshes, sharp metallic deflections, one heavier final sword-and-spear collision with resonant ringing, brief spark crackle, foot friction on stone, dust movement, and leaves stirred by the final shockwave.

Dialogue remains clean and foregrounded without excessive reverberation.
